question: Why did the carousel come to a stop?
answer: The person in the blue shirt pulled it to a stop.

options.text: A child grabbed the carousel, bringing it to a stop.
The person in the blue shirt pushed it to a stop.
A child jumped off, causing the carousel to stop.
The carousel slowed naturally due to friction alone.
The carousel ran out of momentum on its own.

evidences.rationale: The person in the blue shirt is seen standing next to the carousel, gradually bringing it to a stop through a pulling motion.
